title: A writable Codex root's in-repo PowerShell file edit was rejected "blocked by policy"; classify which layer refused it
outcome: Agents know which shell edits a writable Codex root may run, and a refusal names its layer and reason.
acceptance: The refusing layer is identified with evidence (Codex runtime exec policy or TermAl configuration) and recorded with the rule that matched.
If the refusal is intended, agent-facing guidance says which edit route to use; if it is not, the rule is corrected and a test covers the command shape.
